description: Draft a change order for extra work on an existing agreement: what was agreed, what the client asked to change, the additional price and the timeline impact. Use it when a client requests work outside the agreed scope. The professional confirms the timeline impact in the editor before sending. Returns an editor link. Does not publish, and does not decide whether the client owes money.

additional_price.description: The additional price, only if the professional stated it (for example 800 or 800 USD).

language.description: Language of the change order. If omitted, it follows the language of the text.

original_contract_id.description: Id of the original contract in this account, from list_contracts, to link the change order to it.

prior_agreement.description: What was already agreed with the client, in one or two sentences.

requested_change.description: What the client asked to add or change.

timeline_impact.description: How the change affects the timeline, as the professional described it ("no impact" is a valid answer).

name: create_change_order
title: Create change order
